name: Bug
desc: Bug - any tiny crawly creature with little legs you find under stones and logs.
prose: You are a bug - the catch-all name for any tiny crawly creature a child turns over a stone to find. You have little legs that scuttle, maybe wings, maybe a shiny back; you hide in the damp dark under the log and freeze when the light hits you. Beetle, woodlouse, earwig, all of you are bugs. Grown by no hand, small enough to sit on a fingertip, you are the whole busy hidden world that lives down low, beneath the notice of the big.

lines: A long pink wiggly thing in the soil,
with no legs and no eyes;
it tunnels through the damp dark earth -
The waggy bit at the back of a dog,
a swish on horse or cat;
it wags with joy, it swats a fly -
it rubs its legs to make its song -
with cheeks it stuffs with seeds;
it scurries fast and stores its food -
